newsitem.title: CHINA: China's new brokerages thrive amid competition.
newsitem.headline: China's new brokerages thrive amid competition.

text.p: New brokerages in China have become major players on China's stock markets in the first half of this year at a time of increased competition for securities business, the Shanghai Securities News said on Tuesday.
"Since the start of this year -- no matter for new share issues on the primary market or stock trading business -- new faces have appeared on the list of major brokerages," the newspaper said.
CITIC Securities, established two years ago, has become the fourth biggest underwriter on the primary market, underwriting 11 issues in the first half, it said.
Turnover of another new brokerage, Zhejiang International Trust and Investment Co, hit 30.93 billion yuan in the first six months, up 4.2 times from the same period in 1996, the newspaper said.
Many small brokerages have tried to boost their capital and establish more offices to compete with bigger players, it said.
